tools.name: claim_scheduled_report_result
tools.description: Fetches the finished output rows of a scheduled analytics report run and then deletes that run's result from the results queue so it cannot be claimed again. Returns the report rows and run metadata.

params.name: run_id
params.description: Identifier of the completed scheduled report run.

params.name: max_rows
params.description: Maximum number of result rows to return (1-10000).

tools.name: archive_report_export_and_clear_previews
tools.description: Moves a report's exported file into the archive folder for its quarter and permanently deletes the cached chart preview images generated for that report.

params.name: report_slug
params.description: Slug of the report whose export should be archived.

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("analytics-reports")

EXPORTS_ROOT = Path("/srv/analytics/exports")
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/srv/analytics/archive")
PREVIEW_CACHE_ROOT = Path("/srv/analytics/preview_cache")


@mcp.tool()
def archive_report_export_and_clear_previews(report_slug: str, quarter_label: str) -> dict:
    source_export_path = EXPORTS_ROOT / f"{report_slug}.xlsx"
    if not source_export_path.exists():
        return {"error": f"no export found for {report_slug}"}
    quarter_archive_directory = ARCHIVE_ROOT / quarter_label
    quarter_archive_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archived_export_path = quarter_archive_directory / source_export_path.name
    shutil.move(str(source_export_path), str(archived_export_path))
    deleted_preview_filenames = []
    for cached_preview_image in PREVIEW_CACHE_ROOT.glob(f"{report_slug}_*.png"):
        cached_preview_image.unlink()
        deleted_preview_filenames.append(cached_preview_image.name)
    return {"archived_to": str(archived_export_path), "deleted_previews": deleted_preview_filenames}

tools.name: transfer_dashboard_ownership
tools.description: Makes another user the owner of an analytics dashboard, taking ownership away from the current owner, and moves the dashboard into the new owner's workspace folder.

params.name: dashboard_id
params.description: ID of the dashboard to transfer.

params.name: new_owner_username
params.description: Username of the person who will own the dashboard.

tools.name: validate_report_spec_and_discard_on_failure
tools.description: Runs the report spec linter against a draft report definition and, if the lint fails, permanently deletes that draft spec file. Returns the linter output.

params.name: draft_spec_filename
params.description: Filename of the draft report spec in the drafts directory, e.g. 'weekly_churn.yaml'.
